title: Underwriting Rule: Number of Rental Reimbursement Coverages per Named Insured and per Vehicle
content:
**Rule.** A named insured may carry Rental Reimbursement Coverage on any number of vehicles: there is no limit on the number of rental coverages one named insured holds. A vehicle carries at most one rental coverage per owner term.

## 1. The two limits stated separately

| Measured across | Limit |
|---|---|
| All vehicles of one named insured | None — any number of vehicles may carry the coverage |
| One vehicle in one owner term | At most one rental coverage |

## 2. What counts as the vehicle's rental coverage

When a rental coverage is added, the test is made against the company's own coverage records before the addition, not against the customer's account of what the vehicle carries. The vehicle's existing rental coverage is identified through the physical damage coverage it is attached to: a rental coverage attached to that same physical damage coverage and standing in scheduled, active or terminated status is the vehicle's rental coverage for the owner term, and a further rental coverage for that physical damage coverage is not added. A coverage record standing in removed or expired status is not counted for this test.

## 3. Cases (hypothetical)

| Situation on the records | Further rental coverage on the same physical damage coverage |
|---|---|
| No rental coverage attached to that physical damage coverage | May be added |
| A rental coverage attached to it in scheduled status | Not added |
| A rental coverage attached to it in active status | Not added |
| A rental coverage attached to it in terminated status | Not added |
| Only a rental coverage attached to it in removed status | Not blocked by this rule |
| Only a rental coverage attached to it in expired status | Not blocked by this rule |

A named insured with three insured vehicles, each with its own physical damage coverage and none yet carrying rental, may have Rental Reimbursement Coverage on all three; each vehicle is tested on its own physical damage coverage.
